name: Session series: a capacity session repeats weekly at 18:00 in Berlin across DST
note: Europe/Berlin moves from CET (UTC+1) to CEST (UTC+2) on Sunday 2026-03-29 at 01:00Z. Monday Mar 23 18:00 local is CET, 17:00Z. Mondays Mar 30 and Apr 6 are CEST, 16:00Z. A capacity series materializes one session per expected instant, so the materialization job must produce these three session starts and no duplicate on a second run.
